name: RSS Reader
summary: An RSS, Atom and JSON Feed reader for iPhone, Android and the desktop that stays on your device: feeds are checked from the device itself, with smart feeds, folders, stars, OPML import and export and reader view. Inspired by NetNewsWire.

screenshots.alt: RSS Reader shows smart feeds and folders, an article timeline with unread dots and stars, and a selected article with toolbar

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence. Design inspired by NetNewsWire (MIT, Brent Simmons and Ranchero Software), with features chosen from NetNewsWire's public feature requests (https://github.com/Ranchero-Software/NetNewsWire/issues); no NetNewsWire code is included.

permissions.label: Check the feeds you subscribe to straight from this device, and fetch an article page when you ask for reader view
Keep your subscriptions, articles and read state on this device only; nothing is sent to ForkMesh
Import and export your subscriptions as an OPML file you pick
Send an article's title and link to a person or channel you pick in chat
